def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    rsi_values = [
        40.5, 42.3, 41.8, 45.2, 47.6,
        49.0, 51.3, 48.7, 46.8, 44.9,
        42.1, 39.5, 37.2, 36.4, 35.0
    ]
    lookback_period = 5

    # Use the final 5-day RSI window
    final_window = rsi_values[-lookback_period:]
    min_rsi = min(final_window)
    max_rsi = max(final_window)
    current_rsi = final_window[-1]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    if max_rsi == min_rsi:
        stoch_rsi = 0.0
    else:
        stoch_rsi = (current_rsi - min_rsi) / (max_rsi - min_rsi)

    answer = round(stoch_rsi, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
